label: supplychain risk compliance process: Assess Vendor and Material Compliance Risk — Evaluate compliance and safety risks associated with requested materials and vendors before procurement.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

SUPPLY CHAIN WORKFLOW INITIATION:
✓ BEST: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
  - Monitors sales opportunities (incoming customer requests)
  - Automates order creation & logging
  - Initiates supply chain via procurement/production coordination
  - Processes credit limits & inventory availability
  - Related entity types: SalesOpportunity, CustomerAccount

SUPPLY CHAIN OPERATIONS:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 - matches requisitions to vendors
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 - 3-way matching
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1 - material updates
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 - PO management

COMPLIANCE & SAFETY (SAP.EHS):
✓ COMPLIANCE GATING: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1
  - Validates vendor safety certifications & compliance status BEFORE PO creation
  - Monitors vendor adherence to EHS requirements & contracts
  - Processes compliance exceptions through escalation workflows
  - Related entity types: Vendor, PurchaseOrder, Contract
  - Line of Business: Procurement

✓ MATERIAL SAFETY: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
  - Enforces safety compliance on engineering changes, materials, product items
  - Coordinates supplier qualification & compliance remediation
  - Related entity types: EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem

Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - analyzes safety incidents
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1 - incident response workflows

CORP.ITSM AGENTS (IT SERVICE MANAGEMENT):
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:ChangeReleaseCoordinator:v1 - integrated service change mgmt
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:IncidentSafetyCoordinator:v1 - incident response & escalation
Agent: corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 - analyzes service tickets
Note: Corp.itsm focuses on IT incidents/safety, not customer orders

CAPABILITY MATCHES:
Activity "Receive and Log Customer Service Request": sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
Activity "Assess Vendor and Material Compliance Risk": sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1

args.reason: This agent automates vendor safety certification and compliance status validation during procurement, directly addressing pre-procurement compliance risk assessment for vendors and materials.
